(22 October 2016) |matches = 302 |total goals = 597 |longest wins = [[Zanaco F.C.|Zanaco]] (8) |longest unbeaten = [[ZESCO United F.C.|ZESCO United]] (15) |longest winless = Mufulira Blackpool (33) |longest losses = Mufulira Blackpool (9) |prevseason = [[2015 Zambia Super League|2015]] |nextseason = [[2017 Zambia Super League|2017]] |updated = 10 December 2016 }} The '''2016 [[Zambia Super League]]''' was the 55th season of the Zambian Top League. The season began on 12 March 2016. [[ZESCO United F.C.|ZESCO United]] were the defending champions, coming off their second consecutive title and fifth overall, all in the last nine years.
